title: The scratch fence-cause detail lengthens every source-change fence in worktrees nested under .tmp/ (.tmp/wt-*), and its routed key is case-folded
outcome: A routine source-change fence in a worktree nested under another checkout's .tmp/ keeps a short cause, while a .tmp-naming path the scratch exemption was expected to cover but did not still carries the full detail; the routed key is labelled as case-folded (or shown exact) so it does not read as a mismatch with the exact keys.
acceptance: A source change in a worktree nested under .tmp/ (for example <main>/.tmp/wt-x/src/a.rs) fences with the plain cause, and a test shows it.

A .tmp-naming path the exemption was expected to cover but did not — including when the worktree root resolves to something other than the gate's worktree — still carries the full detail, and a test shows it.
The full gate passes on the exact committed tree.
